---
title: "popEVE is out in Nature Genetics"
date: 2025-11-24
categories: [Paper]
description: "A proteome-wide, calibrated score for every missense variant, built from evolution and human population data."
---

Our collaboration with the Marks lab at Harvard Medical School on popEVE is now published in *Nature Genetics*. popEVE combines evolutionary sequences across species with human population data to give every possible missense variant a score that is comparable across the whole proteome.

Read the [summary](../../papers/2025-popeve/index.qmd) or the [paper](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41588-025-02400-1).
